rationale: Price is at 98.6% of today's range, just $0.17 below the session high of $148.08, after a massive gap-down and intraday recovery of ~$12 from the low — the easy move has already occurred. Entering long here chases exhaustion at the top of the range with minimal reward-to-risk, while a short against a strong earnings beat and bullish momentum also lacks a clear mechanical trigger. With an existing SHOP long already open and a working UPST order consuming available capital, adding more exposure at this extended level is not warranted.
